profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Aledade
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a lightweight NPM library that will help developers design their Progressive Web Applications, specifically the offline capabilities, by managing syncing between the main NoSQL database to a local IndexedDB database.

Utilized IndexedDB as a large capacity local storage solution, without the use of 3rd party libraries to preserve the lightweightedness of the library, which can be accessed asynchronously to track and sync changes made offline.

Engineered our library to be implemented solely within a Service Worker to minimize any alteration to an application’s client and server-side code, and to utilize Service Worker’s available caching features.

Employed a “network first then cache” caching strategy to cache all static assets and requests, while concurrently intercepting requests with dynamic responses to perform custom IndexedDB operations.

Demonstrated the functionalities of the NPM library by building a performant, offline-capable, multi-page application utilizing Next.js’ functionalities such as flexible CSR, SSR, SSG, and customizable back-end server.

Generated bundled versions of the library in .ems and .umd formats using Rollup to provide wider compatibility options, and also to allow the library to be served by jsDelivr to the Service Worker via importScripts().

Product developed under tech accelerator OS Labs (opensourcelabs.io)

positions.title: Staff Mechanical Engineer
positions.description:
Kicked-off an automation pipeline utilizing Python for its versatility and huge library support, to generate XML scripts that can be directly imported to Flotherm thermal simulation software to automate tasks.

Mentored junior-level engineers and trained other mechanical engineers on how to utilize internal/external tools used for thermal analysis and simulations.

positions.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
positions.description:
Lead the system-level thermal and structural analysis group in developing internal test platforms and reference designs for 5G related mobile and infrastructure products.

Designed and performed reliability testing of various gel/grease Thermal Interface Materials placed under variable spring loads, utilizing custom test fixtures, thermocouples, thermal simulations, and 
CSAM images to quantify the test results.

Developed a VBA script to automate the process of organizing a large number of temperature-dependent power data in a system, which allowed Flotherm to more accurately capture the thermal behavior of a system accounting for leakage.

positions.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
positions.description:
Generated 3D models and drawings of smart medical devices utilizing Creo Parametric CAD software which allowed top-down design methodologies and easier handling of larger relational assemblies.

Redesigned an insulin pen to include smart functionalities, retrofitting a flex circuit board and plastic snap features to minimally invade the existing design and assembly process.
 
Designed the plastic housing for a PoE box with ambient temperature, and light-sensing functionalities, optimizing the housing design in accordance with thermal analysis to obtain more accurate temperature sensor readings.

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer
positions.description:
Generated a Function Block Diagram program using Siemens LOGO! Soft Comfort software to monitor and control analog/digital inputs and outputs of a rapid-fire shock tube. 

Designed test fixtures, utilizing SolidWorks to develop 3D models and drawings, accounting for DFMA, usability, and cost-efficiency. 

Revamped an existing 3D FSI simulation in LS-DYNA by replacing the geometry and mesh, redefining the boundary conditions, and varying the load applied to the structure.

positions.title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Developed a VBA script to automate the process of converting legacy SolidWorks drawing and 3D model database into a format that will conform to the new product data management software.

Assisted in establishing the company’s singular format for its document numbering system by leveraging
SolidWorks PDM Works to create and manage a master vault system.
